Rewrite this paleontology period overview to be roughly one-third of its original length (around 40-50 words maximum). Keep it as a very broad, basic overview without excessive detail. Split it into two very short paragraphs. Return ONLY the rewritten text, no conversational filler.

Original:
The Mid Cretaceous was an extreme greenhouse epoch characterized by soaring global temperatures, high sea levels, and ice-free poles.

Vast inland seas deposited thick chalk beds, while giant carnivorous dinosaurs roamed landmasses reshaped by the earliest flowering plants.
